title: One room, three possibilities
lede: The living space of Possibility House, seen from one fixed point. Choose a template and the same room rebuilds itself around it: finishes, fabrics, furniture and light.

base.name: The room as built
base.line: Screed floor, limewash walls, a quiet daylight shell.
base.alt: The double-height living room with a pale screed floor, limewash walls, tall curtained glazing and a low sofa group.

templates.name: Travertine Morning
templates.line: Honed stone underfoot, pale oak behind, low morning sun through linen.
templates.alt: The same room in morning light: honed travertine floor, pale oak wall panels, ivory linen curtains, charcoal rug, olive plant.
materials: Pale oak veneer panels, three tiers

templates.name: Oak Evening
templates.line: Fumed oak on floor and wall, dark wool, lamps on at dusk.
templates.alt: The same room at dusk: smoked oak floor and wall panels, charcoal wool sofa, warm lamps and a mid-century lounge chair.

templates.name: Verde Studio
templates.line: Deep green lime plaster, pale oak, a terracotta sofa in clear midday light.
templates.alt: The same room at midday: green tadelakt wall, pale oak floor boards, terracotta sofa, natural linen curtains and a large plant.
